honest_limits: L-C2-1: phi_spatial proxy is 🟢 NUMERICAL (RFC 036 spatial-slice replica of phi_rs with n_bins=4), NOT 🔵 IIT 4.0 full MIP / cause-effect structure / exclusion. 'Φ' here = production Φ-ratchet input, not canonical IIT Φ.

L-C2-2: merge operationalization = element-wise linear average (0.5*(s_A[i,t]+s_B[i,t])) on obs trajectories — the H_054 Cycle #1 mass-conserving primitive (B-MITOSIS-2). Alternative merge primitives (asymmetric/keeper-preserve = H_203 sister; max-pool; multiplicative) would yield different Φ patterns and are not tested here.

L-C2-3: pre-merge 'isolated' = two distinct seeds on the SAME lattice geometry. Truly disconnected substrate (separate physical lattices with their own diffusion topology) is a stronger isolation; here we use seed-divergence as the operationalization (cheap proxy).

L-C2-4: super-additivity (Φ_symbiotic > Φ_sum) — even if observed — does NOT entail phenomenal binding (H_004 hard problem boundary carries unchanged); IIT super-additivity is necessary, not sufficient for unified macro-consciousness.

L-C2-5: small substrate (N=8 cells × DIM=8 steps × n_bins=4) — endosymbiotic real-organism scale (eukaryote ≥ 10^13 mitochondria) is many orders out; this is a toy substrate sanity probe, NOT a scaling claim.

L-C2-6: ratio Φ_symbiotic/Φ_sum substrate-dependent — running C2 on different lattice topologies/coupling/seed-base yields different ratios. The numerical value reported here is one (frozen) substrate instance, not a universal constant.
L-C2-7: single-cycle one-shot — no multi-seed averaging across (SEED_A,SEED_B) pairs. A robust effect would require ≥5 seed-pair sweep; this is a single deterministic measurement (cheap-path 🟢).
